test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Partial
solution:
The correct answer is **"Unbiased."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"partial"** means showing favoritism or bias towards one side. (किसी वस्‍तु को अत्‍यधिक पसंद करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** *He’s very **partial**__ to his friend.*
 
 
 
• The word **"unbiased"** means showing no prejudice for or against something; impartial.
 __
 
• **Example:** *H**is assessment of the benefits and drawbacks was **unbiased**__. *(किसी चीज़ के पक्ष या विपक्ष में कोई पूर्वाग्रह नहीं दिखाना; निष्पक्ष)
 
 
 
• The antonym of **'partial' **is **'unbiased.'**
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Unjust** means unfair or not morally right. (अनुचित या अन्‍यायपूर्ण)
 
• **Prejudiced** means having a preconceived opinion or bias towards something or someone. (पूर्वाग्रहग्रस्‍त (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को नापसंद या उस पर अविश्‍वास करने वाला, उसकी जाति, धर्म या लिंग के कारण))
 
• **Doubtful** means uncertain or not sure about something. (संदिग्‍ध या अनिश्चित)
